design_philosophy: A sophisticated, high-contrast Dark Mode PWA with Apple liquid glass aesthetic. Minimalist visual noise, leveraging pure black backgrounds, frosted glass panels, and a single electric accent color. Focus on fluid microinteractions, geometric typography, and abundant negative space.

spacing_and_layout.general: Abundant negative space. Padding values: p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped containers.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style or Control Room grid depending on view. Mobile-first grid-cols-1, md:grid-cols-3 or 4 for dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.container_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for major panels, rounded-xl for inner cards.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned for all form fields and data. Center only for empty states or hero text.

surfaces_and_microinteractions.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10' for modals, navbars, and feature cards.
surfaces_and_microinteractions.buttons: Large touch targets (min h-12). Primary buttons use bg-[#0A84FF] hover:bg-[#0071E3] text-white rounded-xl transition-all.
surfaces_and_microinteractions.animations: On click compression: scale-95 (via Framer Motion). Hover state: slight negative Y translation (-translate-y-1) and border glow.
surfaces_and_microinteractions.icons: Lucide React, stroke-width: 1.5. Linear, thin, minimal.
surfaces_and_microinteractions.tables: Interactive sortable headers, sticky headers, thin borders between rows (border-b border-white/5), row hover effect (bg-white/5).

components.buttons: Tailwind standard pure CSS or customized Shadcn Button. Always include scale down on click.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. bg-transparent, border-white/20, focus:border-[#0A84FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A84FF]. Floating labels or minimal placeholders.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog wrapped in Framer Motion for smooth scale-in. backdrop-blur-2xl overlay.
components.calendar: Customized Shadcn Calendar. Hide non-available dates. Use primary accent for selected date.
components.low_stock_alert: Red pulsing dot absolute positioned on the inventory card/row, or a thin red banner.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio > 4.5:1. Never use transparent text or bg without blur.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-service-btn', data-testid='inventory-item-row').

hero_background.description: Dark, moody barber shop interior with glowing neon signs. Use as low opacity background (opacity-20) for the public booking flow landing.

service_barber_profile.description: Man getting a haircut at a modern barber. Use for service placeholder or barber profile avatar if needed.

inventory_placeholder.description: Barber tools and clippers on dark background. Use for inventory module empty state or placeholder.

modules_instructions.1_Role_Access: Owner dashboard: simple table view of emails, toggle switches (Shadcn Switch) to admit/deny access.
modules_instructions.2_Booking_Flow: Multi-step wizard for clients. Step 1: Grid of services. Step 2: Grid of barbers. Step 3: Interactive calendar (date + time slots). Step 4: Form + LocalStorage save checkbox. Finish: Success screen with WhatsApp redirect simulation.
modules_instructions.3_Manager_Dashboard: Stats at top (Appointments, Revenue). Quick filter pills below stats. Main area: List of today's appointments. Click appointment -> Slide-out panel (Sheet component) with details.
modules_instructions.4_Inventory: CRUD list/grid. Highlight low stock items. 'Generate Purchase Order' button at top right that compiles low stock items into a modal list for review.
